findings.reason: a missing depends-on lets the sections land in an order where §8's central gate cannot pass, and a worker would either fail or invent the account fields itself.
findings.text: §8's callers block is two levels of `account` and `project` drawn "from the request record (§13)" (line 348), but `plan-section-depends-on` declares only `s9→s8` and `s10→s3,s9`, so nothing records that s8 needs s13; s8 can therefore be dispatched before s13 exists and its fixture with two accounts and three projects cannot be built

findings.reason: a section that needs an operator lane cycle is scheduled by no step, so a coordinator reads §8 as deployable in step 1 and the accounts table is inert in production with no step owning its activation.
findings.text: §11's four rollout steps carry §3/§6/§8/§9/§10 (step 1, "no service impact"), §4/§5/§7 (step 2, operator lane cycle), the B300 and the alias, and never name §13, although §13 edits `router.py` and `request_receipts.py` and its own paragraph places it at "the next lane cycle" under operator authority; step 1's "§8 ... land and are used on today's single engine" is therefore wrong for the accounts half of §8, which stays unattributed until the §13 router change deploys

findings.reason: a worker taking the gate literally must drop the account grouping to make it pass, and one taking the prose literally fails a gate the plan's own design guarantees will be red.
findings.text: §8's first done-when requires "the callers block equal what `agent watch --json --live` emits at the base revision", while §8's mechanism (lines 340-350) adds an `accounts` level, a `projects` level and an `account`/`project` field on every per-session entry; the base block at `imas_ambix/agent/lane_callers.py:98` groups only by session or host and emits none of those keys, so the equality cannot hold

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `/imas-ambix/research/serving-capacity-and-b300-projection`, `/imas-ambix/plans/local-lane-admission-control`, `/imas-ambix/plans/serving-record-warehouse`, `docs/figures/serving-across-servers/topology.svg` and `ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md` all resolve with `.html` appended where extensionless, and the cited code anchors all exist (`RouterApp._publish_lane` reads `upstreams[0]` at router.py:2131, `_GenerationGate`, `_record_self_answer`, `SELF_ANSWERED_UPSTREAM = "(router)"` in request_receipts.py:68, `_preferred_owner`, `WORKING_HORIZON_SECONDS = 180.0`, `newest_raw_receipt`, `SiteConfig.preferred_release_id`, `identity_from_headers` with exactly two router call sites at router.py:2087 and :2654, `_identity_token`, and `reckon.crew.lane_document.read_lane_document`).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — every implementable section (§3, §4, §5, §6, §7, §8, §9, §10, §11, §13) now names at least one negative control, and each control is a condition that can fail (an undeclared server, an over-wide pause, a stopped engine, a malformed tail, an expired bound, an over-long header).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the sections gate through the repository's own tests and the rollout's recorded artifacts, and no section routes evidence to a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the proposed symbols and headers state what they measure (`x-ambix-account`, `ACCOUNT_HEADER`, `lanes/<model id>.json`) and carry no plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8's first done-when asserts an equality its own mechanism makes impossible.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3–§10 and §13 each carry one deliverable with one gate; §11 is the rollout narrative rather than a build node.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §8's callers-by-account block is built from `account`/`project`, which §13 adds to the request record, and no `depends-on` relationship declares that dependency; the rollout's §13 step is also missing (§11 lists §3/§6/§8/§9/§10, then §4/§5/§7, then the B300, then the alias).
